lessons: The ticket's Scope fence lists only tests/integration/* files, but the attempt reported chupa/tickets.py at 10.63% unit coverage, below its 11% threshold, with integration tests not counting. Amend the fence and Scope in to add a unit test file, e.g. tests/unit/test_tickets_context.py.

Once a unit test file is fenced, put unit tests on the one shared excerpt function the ticket requires. Cover a Python name, Class.method with a decorator, a Markdown heading through the next same-or-higher heading, and each of the four finding cases.

Keep the integration acceptance tests the ticket names (test_context_section_renders_only_the_section, test_context_section_findings, test_context_whole_file_unchanged). The attempt said both verification commands passed, so only the coverage shortfall blocked the merge.

After amending the ticket, run chupa review context-sections and fix every finding until it approves. The engine rules require this so every file the change forces, including the new unit test file, is fenced.
